name: Tube Investments of India Ltd
title: Tube Investments of India Ltd - 540762 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Engineering volume tracking revenue growth with no major Q4 price moves; Q4 consolidated PBIT-type profit up ~8% on revenue up 21%, while EV three-wheeler supply was disrupted by a body-in-white supplier and CDMO plant nears commercial output next quarter.
